releaseSummary: Phase 2.4.5 hardens the manifest build fix: the project uses the static public PWA manifest as the canonical manifest and automatically removes stale app/manifest.* metadata routes and generated .next output before typecheck/build. This specifically addresses older checkouts where overlaying a ZIP does not delete files removed by the new release. The Phase 2.4.3 TypeScript 6.0.3/typegen fix is retained.
